newsitem.title: PERU: Italian diplomat's wife found dead off Peru coast.
newsitem.headline: Italian diplomat's wife found dead off Peru coast.

text.p: The wife of an Italian diplomat has been found dead floating in the Pacific Ocean off Peru, embassy and police sources said on Wednesday.
The corpse of Lina Maria Cembrano Porcarelli was discovered Monday, and police were still investigating the cause of her death, Italian Embassy consul Massimo Sassi told Reuters.
"We cannot say at this stage what happened. Tomorrow there will be more news on this," he said.
Police sources confirmed the death of Cembrano Porcarelli, who was married to the embassy's second-in-charge Pietro Porcarelli, but would not comment on the circumstances around it.

Local media reported on Wednesay that the bruised and half- naked body of an unidentified woman had been found off Lima's port of Callao on Monday. La Republica newspaper said the woman's body showed signs of torture and a brutal death.
But there was no official confirmation that it was the same case.
